preservedResponsibilities: Resolves the original paragraph tab properties over an inherited UNO sequence, applies the native replace and clear positions, and retains the source fallback alignments and leader characters.
omittedResponsibilities: No separate tab store is introduced. Layout and UI use the canonical paragraph item.

filenameDivergence.rationale: The original tab methods are partitioned into the tabs source file to retain the repository source-size bound while preserving the original mapper or exporter context.
